data.name: Codex-Named Unit (ability_inner_sea_magic_ism_abilities_other_lst_152)
data.description: You gain access to a blessed forge at the monastery. You gain a +5 sacred bonus on any Craft or Spellcraft checks made when building any metal armor or weapon (magical or otherwise) with the forge. The item's construction time is divided by half.
